changelog: Three builds since 0.0.57, all of them about the Daily Commission — and two of them were fixing ways it could destroy a save. Resume no longer eats the run it offers to continue The worst bug in this batch. Play a Commission, leave it for an ordinary run, come back to the menu: the Daily button said "resume", and pressing it wiped the campaign in progress and started the day over. Two independent faults, either one enough to lose a save on its own — the label was worked out from "a Commission was started today" plus "some save exists", which is not the same thing as "this save is that Commission", and both branches called the function that clears the save. Even a correctly labelled Resume could only ever have destroyed the thing it offered to continue. It asks the save what it is now. The snapshot already knew which day's Commission it belonged to; nothing else can tell today's Commission apart from an ordinary run started the same afternoon. A Commission is one attempt, resumed rather than restarted. Abandoning one and opening it again used to start it over from the same fixed seed — so you could walk away from a bad opening as often as you liked and only finish the run that suited you, with a leaderboard on the other end of it. The Commission now has a save slot of its own, so starting a campaign no longer destroys it and coming back means coming back to where it stood. You can read the rules you are being scored under A Commission's modifiers were invisible once the run started. The curses at least showed up under Medals; Thick Fog and Scarcity appeared nowhere at all — no sign they were even on, and nothing saying what they did. Run details now opens from Settings whenever a run is live, and it explains rather than lists: "Scarcity" on its own never told you your troop cap was two lower, which is the exact number you were looking at in the HUD wondering why it said 4. The standings exist outside the run-end screen. The leaderboard was wired only to the card you see when a run finishes, so until you completed a Commission there was no way to see what you were playing against — or that a board existed. The Commission popup shows it now, from the menu, before you commit an attempt. Smaller - Run details used to throw outside a battle and take Settings down with it, so on the map it read as "that button just closes the window". - An empty board says so instead of showing nothing. - Reset All Progress is behind the debug gate. It was one tap from ordinary Settings on a shipping build, and it erases achievements, unlocks, collection and history. Starting a new campaign never needed it. Under the hood The macOS Steam build now exists — built, signed and notarized the same way this one is. It changes nothing about the build you are running here; the two are separate channels and this one keeps its updater.
